notes: Dry deciduous forest and wetlands of the west: Kirindy and Bemaraha forest (Giant Coua, Red-capped Coua), the lakes and marshes of Mahajanga, the Betsiboka delta and Lake Kinkony (Madagascar Fish-Eagle, Humblot's Heron, Madagascar Jacana, Sakalava Rail, ducks, storks and herons) and the shorebirds, terns and Crab-Plover of the west coast. Ankarafantsika (Sickle-billed Vanga, White-breasted Mesite, Schlegel's Asity, Coquerel's Coua) is part of the country trip. Hand-picked; ranges are set from memory and eBird province lists. Left out for lack of usable photos: Kittlitz's Plover and White-fronted Plover.
